kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستشهد (form X)
# أَسْتَشْهِدُ (ʔastašhidu) /ʔas.taʃ.hi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# أُسْتَشْهَدُ (ʔustašhadu) /ʔus.taʃ.ha.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
# أَسْتَشْهِدَ (ʔastašhida) /ʔas.taʃ.hi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
